about.body: The S55 is BMW M's twin-turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, produced from 2013 to 2020. It was developed specifically for M-division applications, serving as the high-performance variant of the N55 engine family. The S55 is fitted across three core M models: the F80 M3, F82/F83 M4, and the F87 M2 Competition. Its production run ended in 2020, making it the defining engine of that generation of M cars. For most of these applications, the S55 is paired with a seven-speed M DCT transmission.

byModel.body: The M2 Competition (F87, 2018–2021) received the S55 as the upgrade over the standard M2's N55 engine. The M3 (F80, 2014–2020) and M4 (F82/F83, 2014–2020) both use the S55 in standard and Competition forms, making this engine the core of BMW M's turbocharged inline-six era before the current S58 replaced it.

compatibility.body: Because the S55 spans only three model lines — M2 Competition, M3 and M4 — compatibility is more straightforward than some of the broader BMW engine families. However, a used S55 from an M3 isn't necessarily a direct fit for an M2 Competition without confirming the exact specification. Matching by registration/VIN is still required before any rebuild or replacement is confirmed.
